document.title: Studies on Polyol Metabolism in Aspergillus niger* III. Purification and Properties of Sorbitol Dehydrogenase
document.abstract: Sorbitol dehydrogenase has been purified about 26 fold from a strain of Aspergillus niger, growing on sorbitol as the sole source of carbon. An absolute specificity of this enzyme for sorbitol, fructose, NAD and NADtt was observed. The Km for sorbitol and fructose were found to be 9.8 X 10 -5 M and 6.6• 10 -4 M respectively. The enzyme was inhibited by pCMB, NaF and other metal ions studied. The enzyme was slightly activated by Fe +++.
